findingClass: a public API route (web/app/api/**, excluding /api/admin/**) serves a "verdict" or "witnesses" JSON key -- OD-61: consensus disagreement must stay admin-only, never visible to a reader
failThreshold: any enumerated public web/app/api/** route's response body contains a quoted "verdict" or "witnesses" key
unverifiableWhen: any enumerated public route is unreachable (shares the e_route_sweep loop's coverage -- a sweep with holes and no failures is BLIND, not green)
sourceTask: S7 (docs/design/s7-consensus-check-plan.md) half 2, OD-61 ("keep everything admin only... no user should not see any disagreement")
scope: every web/app/api/** route NOT under /api/admin/** (admin routes excluded by design -- disputes live on the admin surface)
consumerReason: reuses the existing e_route_sweep enumeration+fetch loop in the SAME script -- a second sweep script would drift out of sync with the route list and double outbound traffic against a box that serves production
